newsitem.title: LEBANON: Prisoners call hunger strike in Gaza, West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Prisoners call hunger strike in Gaza, West Bank.

text.p: Palestinian political prisoners in self-rule areas will begin an indefinite hunger strike on Thursday in protest againt their imprisonment, the Islamic militant group Hamas said in Beirut on Wednesday.

"Political prisoners and detainees in all Palestinian prisons in the self-ruled territories will go on an open-ended hunger strike tomorrow morning until they are released," Hamas representative in Lebanon Mustapha Liddawi told Reuters in a telephone call.
Liddawi said the decision was taken by some 70 prisoners in Gaza's central prison, 10 in the city's protective security prison, and an unknown number of prisoners in West Bank jails.
"The representatives of the leading Islamic and leftist Palestinian opposition groups inside these prisons informed us of the decision," Liddawi said.

Last year, the Palestinian authorities -- under pressure from Israel -- launched a campaign against Islamic militants in self-rule areas after a wave of suicide bombings which killed scores of people in Israel.
More Islamic militants and Palestinian leftists, opposed to Palestinian-Israeli peace, have been arrested since and some are being held without trial, Liddawi said.
